Example gallery

Complete diagrams to open, study and adapt. Each one is laid out by hand, so its link carries node positions as well as source.

Flowchart

Diamonds for decisions, colored edge labels for the branches, and a dashed retry loop.

State machine

Hexagons for states. Solid edges are the happy path and dashed edges are exceptions.

Org chart

Sizes and colors show the hierarchy.

Architecture with icons

Image nodes using the icons that ship with these docs. Any image URL works.

Network

A dark background, a bold ingress path, and dotted lines to the database tier.

Data pipeline

A left-to-right flow with a linked source and labeled schedules.

Git branches

Small circles for commits, none nodes as branch labels, and colors per branch.

Course prerequisites

A dependency graph, with a dashed edge for a recommendation.

Link hub

Every node is a bookmark. Click a node in the editor to open its link.

Solar system

Sizes and colors on a black background, each body linked to its Wikipedia article.

Mind map

A topic map of these docs, with each branch linked to its page.

The editor's starter diagram

The diagram the editor shows when opened without a link, or after Reset.
